title: Base-ten blocks
notes: Light wood blocks at one unit size: 1 thousand cube, 2 hundred flats, 3 ten rods and 4 ones, so it shows 1,234.

title: Linking cubes
use: UnitCubes and CubeTrains pictures (counting, adding, volume)
notes: A train of 5 snapped-together blue cubes and 3 loose cubes (red, yellow, green), each with its connector nub: shows 5 + 3.

title: Pattern blocks
use: PatternBlocks picture (shapes, fractions of a hexagon)
notes: The six blocks in their standard colors (yellow hexagon, red trapezoid, blue rhombus, green triangle, orange square, tan thin rhombus) and a hexagon made of a trapezoid, a rhombus and a triangle.

title: Two-color counters
use: TenFrame counters and counting pictures (two-color counters)
notes: Round counters red on one side and yellow on the other: 4 showing red, 2 showing yellow and 1 standing on its edge.

title: Ten frame
notes: A 2 by 5 ten frame with 7 red counters: the top row full, 2 in the bottom row; shows 7 (3 more make 10).
